newsitem.title: FRANCE: Air France to up Madras cargo flights.
newsitem.headline: Air France to up Madras cargo flights.

text.p: Air France said its Boeing 747-200 freighter fleet will be flying to Madras three times weekly from the end of October compared to twice weekly currently.

"We have been looking to put on additional westbound capacity from Madras for some time as the city and its region generates a significant volume of textile goods destined for Europe and the U.S, an Air France Cargo official told Reuters.
Madras will form part of a westbound itinerary probably reading, Taipei-Madras-Dubai-Paris, the official said.
Madras currently features on Air France's ex-Paris 747-200F service to the Indian sub-continent. --Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 8982 Fax +44 171 542 5017
